paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Shalom, in R. Abbahu's time—I have not found that dating. R. Yehudah son of R. Shalom expounded: Bava Batra 10a. R. Mattanyah: Jerusalem HaBoneh, halakhah 4. Gittin, chapter 2, halakhah 3; Megillah 1:11: R. Yudan bar Yudan bar Shalom. [The checked Megillah reads Yudan bar Shalom at 1:9:2.] Shocher Tov, section 106, has R. Yudan son of R. Yudan. He raised a question before R. Yosi: Demai 6:3. [The checked passage is at 6:2:10.] R. Yaisa is R. Assi in Jerusalem Talmud language. Zohar, Shemot, locator סעכ״ו [the encounter is at II 16b in the checked edition]: he walked with R. Abba, and a man named Lachma bar Levi met them; see the story.
